lessons.title: Má + séimhiú
lessons.rule: Má (if) puts séimhiú on the verb after it: bíonn becomes má bhíonn, feiceann becomes má fheiceann. Tá, deir and verbs that begin with a vowel do not change (má tá, má deir, má itheann). Use the present tense after má even when you mean the future: Má bhíonn sé fliuch amárach, fanfaidh muid istigh. Never put the future tense after má.
steps: Put the verb in the present: bíonn.
Add séimhiú after má: má bhíonn.
The other half can be in the future: fanfaidh muid istigh.

example.prompt: Má (bí) sé fliuch amárach, fanfaidh muid istigh.
example.answer: Má bhíonn sé fliuch amárach, fanfaidh muid istigh.
example.alt: Má bhíonn sé fliuch amárach, fanfaimid istigh.

more.prompt: Má (feic) tú Ciara, abair léi glaoch a chur orm.
more.answer: Má fheiceann tú Ciara, abair léi glaoch a chur orm.

lessons.hint: Má + h + the present. Tá, deir and vowels: no change.

lessons.title: Má + an aimsir chaite
lessons.en: If, in the past: má with the past tense
lessons.rule: Má can also go with the past tense. The verb stays exactly as it is in the past, with its séimhiú or d': má chuaigh sé, má d'ith tú, má fuair sí. Nothing is added and nothing is taken away.
steps: Put the verb in the past: chuaigh.
Write má in front of it and change nothing: má chuaigh.
Finish the sentence: Má chuaigh sé abhaile, cuirfidh mé scairt air.

example.prompt: Má (téigh, an aimsir chaite) sé abhaile, cuirfidh mé scairt air.
example.answer: Má chuaigh sé abhaile, cuirfidh mé scairt air.

more.answer: Má d'ith tú an cáca, admhaigh é!

lessons.hint: Má + the past tense, unchanged: má chuaigh, má d'ith.

lessons.title: Dá + urú + an modh coinníollach
lessons.rule: For something imagined or unlikely (if I were, if I had), use dá: put the verb in the conditional and eclipse it (dá mbeadh, dá bhfaighinn, dá n-éistfeá). The other half is in the conditional too, with séimhiú, or d' before a vowel or f (d'fhanfainn): Dá mbeadh airgead agam, rachainn go Meiriceá. R cannot be eclipsed, so after dá, rachainn and rachfá stay as they are: dá rachfá. With muid and siad either form is right: rachadh muid or rachaimis, bheadh siad or bheidís.
steps: Put bí in the conditional and eclipse it: dá mbeadh.
Put the other verb in the conditional with the right person: rachainn.
Write it: Dá mbeadh airgead agam, rachainn go Meiriceá.

example.prompt: Dá (bí) airgead agam, (téigh) mé go Meiriceá.
example.answer: Dá mbeadh airgead agam, rachainn go Meiriceá.

more.prompt: Dá (bí) airgead againn, (téigh) muid go Meiriceá.
more.answer: Dá mbeadh airgead againn, rachadh muid go Meiriceá.
more.alt: Dá mbeadh airgead againn, rachaimis go Meiriceá.

lessons.hint: Dá + urú + conditional, and the conditional in the other half.

items.answer: Dá mbeadh cead agam, d'fhanfainn amuigh go déanach.

lessons.title: Mura + urú
lessons.rule: Mura (if not) eclipses the verb after it. Like má, it takes the present when you mean the future (Mura mbíonn tú in am, imeoidh an bus gan thú), and tá becomes mura bhfuil. For something imagined, use the conditional: Mura mbeadh sé ag cur báistí, rachainn amach. In Ulster you will also hear and see muna, which is fine: muna mbíonn.
steps: Put the verb in the present: bíonn.
Eclipse it after mura: mura mbíonn.
Finish the sentence: Mura mbíonn tú in am, imeoidh an bus gan thú.

example.prompt: Mura (bí) tú in am, imeoidh an bus gan thú.
example.answer: Mura mbíonn tú in am, imeoidh an bus gan thú.
example.alt: Muna mbíonn tú in am, imeoidh an bus gan thú.

lessons.title: Má, dá nó mura? Sa Chomhrá
lessons.en: Má, dá or mura? In the speaking test
lessons.rule: In the speaking test, listen to the question and look at the other half of your answer. If it is real or likely, use má + séimhiú and the present (or the past). If it is imagined and the other half is in the conditional, use dá + urú. If you mean if not, use mura + urú. You will often be asked Cad é a dhéanfá dá ...?, and your answer starts with Dá.
steps: Read the other half: thabharfainn is in the conditional.
So the if half is imagined: dá + urú + the conditional.
Answer: Dá mbeinn i mo Phríomh-Aire, thabharfainn ...

example.prompt: Cad é a dhéanfá dá mbeifeá i do Phríomh-Aire? _______ (if: bí, mé) i mo Phríomh-Aire, thabharfainn níos mó airgid do na scoileanna agus do na hospidéil.
example.answer: Cad é a dhéanfá dá mbeifeá i do Phríomh-Aire? Dá mbeinn i mo Phríomh-Aire, thabharfainn níos mó airgid do na scoileanna agus do na hospidéil.

more.prompt: An mbeidh tú ag dul chuig an ollscoil? Beidh, _______ (if: faigh, mé) na marcanna atá de dhíth orm.
more.answer: An mbeidh tú ag dul chuig an ollscoil? Beidh, má fhaighim na marcanna atá de dhíth orm.

lessons.hint: Real: má. Imagined, with a conditional: dá. If not: mura.
